translations.web: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.
translations.bsb: If your brother sins against you, go and confront him privately. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.
translations.kjv: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
translations.asv: And if thy brother sin against thee, go, show him his fault between thee and him alone: if he hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
